name: Location 1 - Suburban Cul-de-sac Estate
description: High-density residential subdivision featuring dual cul-de-sacs with red-tile roofs, swimming pools, and rear gardens.

name: Location 2 - Linear Grid Neighborhood
description: Medium-density residential block arranged along regular grid streets with uniform single-family lot divisions.

name: Location 3 - Curvilinear Street Housing Sector
description: Suburban development with curved access roads, consistent roof alignments, and private residential driveways.

name: Location 4 - Multi-Family Residential Complex
description: Structured multi-family housing complex comprising 10 large elongated apartment / residential block structures.

name: Location 5 - Concentric Ring Planned Community
description: Expansive master-planned community with concentric oval streets and high housing density exceeding 130 dwellings.

name: Location 6 - Hillside Perimeter Housing Estate
description: Lower-density residential enclave situated along hillside terrain, flanked by natural green open space and forest canopy.

name: Location 7 - Boulevard-Bordered Residential Tract
description: Residential tract bordered by a major arterial thoroughfare with organized single-family homes and backyard enclosures.

name: Location 8 - Rural-Urban Fringe Residential Cluster
description: Compact residential settlement bordered on the west by undeveloped scrubland/terrain and dense neighborhood streets on the east.

name: Location 9 - Diagonal Parkway Neighborhood
description: Suburban neighborhood traversed diagonally by a tree-lined avenue, featuring medium-sized dwellings and community pool.

name: Location 10 - Terraced Hillside Housing Enclave
description: Semicircular hillside residential development with contoured terraced streets and tightly-spaced family dwellings.
